hadithSharh.firstPriority: Old genuine open Šarḥ gaps (not duplicates) and isnād-critical records; independently add new nonduplicate hadith only with verified early direct Arabic Šarḥ.
hadithSharh.newContentMustHave: Authenticated hadith + exact source number/chapter + verified direct classical Šarḥ with named scholar, work, precise reference and primary link.
hadithSharh.earliestSharh: Research earliest verifiable direct commentary to exact narration/claim; mere citation or later summary is not Šarḥ.
hadithSharh.avoid: No fabricated source, isnād grade, pages, exact wording or semantic duplicates; edition unknown stays null.
hadithSharh.historicalCheckpoint: HAD-3357; verify live head before writing
hadithSharh.continueUntil: No fixed end; continue while genuinely new unique authentic material exists; review backlog separately.

athar.assessment: Verify exact scholar/sahabi attribution, full chain whenever available, mawqūf vs maqtūʿ vs marfūʿ, and credible individual isnād status; never infer ṣaḥīḥ from book or generic label.
athar.unresolvedCases: Use documented needs-review; do not silently present as authenticated; exclude unsafe new records from canonical live content until checked.
athar.backlogNext: HAD-0383–HAD-0392 and genuine old open individual attribution audits, then next 10/20.

quranTadabbur.rule: Only exactly relevant, original, isnād-reviewed early Tafsīr/Tadabbur for each missing Surah:Ayah. Never fabricate to reach 6236.
quranTadabbur.completion: At 6236 independently verified unique verses, mark task complete; do not produce recycled fictitious 'new' verses. Continue only correction/review thereafter.

batch.partialHandling: Record count of inspected vs verified vs unresolved separately; never claim 20 new verified entries if some are blocked. No automatic skip, no repeated reviewing of settled IDs.
progress: Retrieve latest main SHA and saved audit before each block
Read original Arabic source and exact location
Grade independently and identify semantic duplicates
Use fresh file blob SHAs with narrow changes
Update index/catalog/manifest atomically or via proven rebuild and validators
Trigger existing canonical live sync and verify deployment
Save next open cursor and blockers for next run and next chat
batch.commitGrouping: Prefer one atomic Git tree/commit per reviewed 10–20-entry batch (with all changed files, related audit and catalog/manifest), then one canonical workflow/deploy. Never start 10–20 separate deploys just to complete one batch; exceptionally use safe sequential commits when tool does not offer atomic batching and audit that limitation.

globalDelivery.requested: Auto-sync each completed verified canonical content block immediately after write to existing public adult delivery path.
audiences: Adult iOS WebView and native iOS content layer (remote JSON where implemented)
Apple TV app, home and ambient screensaver
globalDelivery.realityGate: Main commit is not live proof: check GitHub Actions job, build/validator, Cloudflare production, accessible content endpoint, cache version/TTL and independent device fetching. Native code/API additions still require iOS/tvOS builds and App Store releases; content JSON does not.
globalDelivery.screensaver: Persistent shuffle bag with full unseen cycle before repetition. New ids append to remaining; never reset on app open or cycle. Verify runtime storage independently.
globalDelivery.noPushNotifications: Content publication to endpoint is not OneSignal or device notification. Never trigger extra subscribers' push or daily editorial post. Existing protected locks remain unchanged.
globalDelivery.independentTracks: Kids excluded unless explicitly instructed. Daily single adult post, q-source cards, Kids, prayer and all push lanes remain separate.
globalDelivery.releaseGranularity: Immediately after each verified 10–20 item block is complete; 'immediately' means no unnecessary delay after the block QA succeeds, not one release per draft file.

progress.verifiedMeaning: 10 source/grade audits completed; NOT 10 newly authenticated transmissions. User's target of 10/20 means work units, not forced success.
progress.nextRequestedBatch: Inspect genuine open Sharḥ and Athar attribution candidates HAD-0393–HAD-0412, but skip any already settled in prior audits. Add new unique Hadith with Šarḥ / independently graded Athar from HAD-3358 onward.
progress.warning: 20 audited/updated ≠ 20 newly authenticated; exactly two HAD-0380 and HAD-0391 identified as securely transmitted in this new 20-item audit; other statuses preserved as pending/weak.
